author: vladthegreat100
body:
As the title says. We should add every gamemode in Mix Servers. They are called "Mix" for a reason.

We Have the Gamemodes: Nexus, and CTH who are never played and the Walls who is played by max 20 people usually.

And we wonder why no one plays them. It's because players either don't know they are there or are just not comfortable going to other gamemodes.
What I'm suggesting is that you guys put every gamemode (except SG because the player count in a DTM/CWT or other gamemodes are too high for SG) in the Mix Servers so everyone can experience a bit of that gamemode and if they do enjoy it they will probably end up checking the actual servers out for said gamemode.

For SG I suggest just getting some way to advertise the SG servers in game so we can get more players there. Or players might even want to try SG cause they tried the others and they enjoyed it! But I suggest fixing the bugs tho.
Ex: You join an SG game and the only way to leave that lobby of SG/game is to relog because apparently all servers and the hub went offline.

If players won't go to the gamemode bring the gamemode to them.
It's best to try and do something to get other players to play a gamemode then complain like a little baby asking why no one plays that gamemode and not changing any of the actions you are doing.

State your opinions down below if you want ^_^
Thanks!
~vladthegreat100
